title: Unidentified objects repeatedly appearing over sensitive nuclear sites

tellings.quote: you know, like there are things in the sky we can't identify that repeatedly show up around our most sensitive nuclear sites.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that there are things in the sky we cannot identify that keep showing up around America's most sensitive nuclear sites. He offers it as a pattern, which, if true, would suggest that whatever these objects are, they take a particular interest in nuclear weapons.
